description: 包格式 v1 两个 aster CLI 共用的错误码、退出码与固定 message（ADR 0059 §4.1 / 实施计划 Global Constraints）。codes 为 formatVersion 1.0 起的错误码；codesSince 按引入它们的包格式次版本列出之后新增的错误码（1.1：ADR 0059 修订 4 D10），支持格式集合 F 的 CLI 的完整错误码表 = codes ∪ ⋃_{v∈F} codesSince[v]。信封 error.message 必须逐字等于本表的 message；诊断细节（文件名、哈希、编译诊断、引擎异常）只写 stderr。

exitCodes.1: 策略求值失败（EVAL_ERROR）或 verify --probes 结果与期望不符（PROBE_MISMATCH）
exitCodes.2: 输入或调用错误（INPUT_INVALID、ENTRY_NOT_FOUND、USAGE；1.1 起另有 DISPLAY_UNMAPPABLE、DISPLAY_AMBIGUOUS、DISPLAY_REJECTED）
exitCodes.4: 包或 IR 不受支持（PKG_INVALID_MANIFEST、PKG_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT、PKG_UNSUPPORTED_IR、PKG_IR_DRIFT、COMPILE_ERROR；1.1 起另有 PKG_DISPLAY_INVALID）

ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.message: entry function not found or not runnable

INPUT_INVALID.message: input does not match the entry's input schema

PKG_IR_DRIFT.message: locally compiled IR differs from the package; use an A package or the CLI version recorded in runtime.cli.version

PKG_UNSIGNED.message: package is unsigned; pass --allow-unsigned to accept it

PKG_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.message: package format version is not supported

PKG_UNSUPPORTED_IR.message: Core IR version is not supported

PKG_UNTRUSTED_KID.message: signing key id is not in the trust anchor

PROBE_MISMATCH.message: a probe result differs from its expected output

DISPLAY_AMBIGUOUS.message: edited display text maps onto the package layout in more than one way

DISPLAY_REJECTED.message: edited display text would hide a value from readers

DISPLAY_UNMAPPABLE.message: edited display text does not map onto the package layout

PKG_DISPLAY_INVALID.message: package display layout is not valid
